svg.title: Data sources and compliance. App Store: iTunes Search API to resolve the app plus the public customer reviews RSS feed; official, public, unauthenticated; post delivery. Reddit: public search.json endpoints per subreddit with no auth, volume capped (default 200), no author handles stored, a 429 shown as rate limited rather than retried hard; the only channel that reaches people before they buy. Play Store: google play scraper against Google's public but undocumented endpoints; unofficial and a terms of service grey area, capped at 300 reviews per platform; post delivery. YouTube: Data API v3, official, free daily quota, optional. The honest framing: app store reviews are a post delivery channel, and the user this brief is about (saved, never bought) leaves no trace there. The Channel Coverage panel prints each channel's measured share of items with a pre purchase signal, and the grounded Q and A says 'the excerpts don't cover this' rather than invent an answer. A failing source reports only a category: not configured, blocked, rate limited, timeout, network, no results, no confident match, upstream error; raw errors, URLs and variable names stay in the server log.

section.data-alt: Data sources and compliance. App Store: iTunes Search API to resolve the app plus the public customer reviews RSS feed; official, public, unauthenticated; post delivery. The honest framing: app store reviews are a post delivery channel, and the user this brief is about (saved, never bought) leaves no trace there. div.p: Each source states how it is collected, its compliance status, and whether it can see a shopper before or after the purchase.
iTunes Search API to resolve the app, plus the public reviews RSS feed.
Public search.json per subreddit, no auth. Capped at 200 by default, no author handles stored.
google play scraper on public but undocumented endpoints. Capped at 300 reviews per platform.
Data API v3, search plus comment threads. Free daily quota.
The shopper who saved something and never bought it leaves no trace in an app store review.
So the Channel Coverage panel prints each channel's measured share of items with a pre purchase signal, and the grounded Q&A box says "the excerpts don't cover this" instead of inventing an answer.

div.div: No leaked internals: a failing source shows only a category
div.p: Raw exception text, upstream URLs, HTTP statuses and variable names go to the server log only, and user facing text passes a scrub as well.
